scripts.text:
[Kafra Leilah]
Hm...?
Oh, welcome to
the Kafra Corporation
Headquarters. Did you
need something?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 莱拉]
嗯...？
啊，欢迎光临卡普拉总公司。
请问有什么需要吗？

scripts.text: Save
scripts.translation: 保存

scripts.text: Use Storage
scripts.translation: 使用仓库

scripts.text: Rent a Pushcart
scripts.translation: 租用手推车

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Kafra Leilah]
Your Respawn Point has
been saved here, inside
of the Kafra Corporation
Headquarters. Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 莱拉]
您的复活点已保存在卡普拉总公司内。
谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Leilah]
Please make use of
the Kafra Services that are
available throughout all of
Midgard. Thank you for
visiting the Kafra Headquarters.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 莱拉]
请善用遍布米德加尔特的卡普拉服务。
感谢光临卡普拉总公司。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Leilah]
Excuse me, but it
seems that you don't
have the 20 zeny to pay
the Storage access fee...
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 莱拉]
抱歉，您似乎没有20 Zeny来支付仓库使用费...

scripts.text:
[Kafra Leilah]
Although this facility is
exclusively intended for
the training of Kafra Employee
and administrative functions,
I'll access your Storage for you.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 莱拉]
虽然这里主要是用于卡普拉 职员培训和行政事务的设施，
但我还是为您打开仓库吧。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Leilah]
In the future, please
ask the Kafra Employee on
duty if you wish to use
any of the Kafra Services.
Thank you for your patronage.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 莱拉]
今后如果您想使用卡普拉服务，
请向当值的卡普拉 职员咨询。
感谢您的惠顾。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Leilah]
My apologies, but I'm
not on duty. I'd assist you
if I could, but actually don't
have any available Pushcarts.
Why don't you ask another Kafra
Employee for assistance?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 莱拉]
抱歉，我现在不在值班。
我很想帮您，但手头没有可用的手推车。
您不妨去问问其他卡普拉 职员？

scripts.text:
[Kafra Leilah]
Kafra Employees are
stationed all over the
Midgard continent,
and you should be able to find
plenty outside in Al De Baran.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 莱拉]
卡普拉 职员遍布米德加尔特大陆，
您在艾尔帕兰外面应该能找到不少。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Leilah]
^666666*Whew...*^000000
Great, because I'm
actually on my break
right now. Choosing
''Cancel'' was a good
move on your part.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 莱拉]
^666666*呼...*^000000
太好了，因为我正好在休息。
你选择“取消”真是明智之举。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
The Kafra Corporation
is always working to provide
you with convenient services.
How may I be of assistance?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
卡普拉公司始终致力于为您提供便捷的服务。
请问有什么可以帮您？

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Welcome~!
The Kafra Services
are always on your side.
So how can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
欢迎~！
卡普拉服务永远在您身边。
请问有什么可以帮您？

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Welcome!
The Kafra Corporation
will always support the
adventurers of Rune-Midgarts
with its excellent service. So
what can I do for you today?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
欢迎光临！
卡普拉公司将始终支持卢恩·米德加兹的冒险者，
提供卓越的服务。请问今天有什么可以帮您？
